claim.claim_context: SYNTHETIC illustration — not a real scientific or medical conclusion.
claim.claim_text: Cities that adopted the app saw less crime, proving the app cuts crime.

evidence_items.text: Adopting cities had lower crime in the same year.

evidence.evidence_sufficiency_rationale: Ecological association with no causal identification.

detected.rationale: No mechanism or design links app adoption to the crime drop.
'Proving ... cuts crime' from an ecological association.

reader_impact.risk_rationale: May drive procurement on weak evidence.

recommended_revision.defensible_rewrite: Cities that adopted the app saw lower crime the same year; this association does not establish that the app caused the drop.
